messages:
taylor_finance: Heads-up — finance update: we've adjusted travel per-diem rates and clarified p-card delegation for FY26. Please read and share. Key points:

1) Per-diem rates (effective 2026-04-01): `Domestic: $125/day`, `International: $220/day`. Mileage follows current IRS rate.
2) Receipts: required for any single expense > $25. Digital photos are fine if legible.
3) Vendor & purchase approvals for R&D: purchases <$3,000 can be approved by manager + finance reviewer; >=$3,000 route to procurement for review.
4) P-card delegations: default monthly limit `=$2,000`. Managers can request temporary bumps up to `=$5,000` for short-term needs (events, recruiting). Requests go through Procurement.

Full policy and examples: https://redwood.atlassian.net/l/c/expense-policies  — exceptions & forms: https://redwood.atlassian.net/l/c/expense-exception  :megaphone:

sam_engineering: Is this retroactive? My team has an offsite booked for 2026-03-20 with airfare + hotel.

taylor_finance: Not retroactive — the new rules apply to spend on or after 2026-04-01. For bookings before that date, submit under the previous policy. If you need an exception (e.g., vendor change, budget impact), please file the expense-exception form and tag @sophia_fd.

jamie_ops: For p-card bump requests, what’s the typical turnaround?

 taylor_finance: Standard turnaround is ~2 business days for routine requests, up to 5 business days for higher limits or cross-org approvals. Submit via Procurement > Requests > P-Card Delegation Request and include a short justification + timeline. Example payload you can paste into the form:

```
team: Eng-Platform
requested_limit: $5,000
period: 1 month
reason: offsite recruiting drive (travel, venue deposit, catering)
```

procurement-bot: Vendor whitelist updated: added "Nimbus Hardware, Inc." for one-off R&D vendor approvals under $3,000. Procurement list: https://redwood.atlassian.net/l/c/vendor-whitelist

sophia_fd: Managers — please ensure budget owners sign off before approving exceptions. I'll follow up with teams that frequently request bumps. :eyes: Thanks @taylor_finance for the clear summary.

alex_sales: Thanks — forwarding to my PMs.

lena_admin: Quick Q: receipts — do we still need PDFs or are phone photos okay?

 taylor_finance: Phone photos are fine as long as they’re legible and show vendor, date, and amount. Use Concur mobile or upload to the expense portal. If anything looks ambiguous finance will ping you for clarification.

(End of thread)
